name: esbozo
description: A small canvas for hand-drawn diagrams, drawn by people and written by agents.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: pnpm build && node scripts/fresh-tmp.mjs node --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.e2e: pnpm build && node scripts/e2e-run.mjs --suite tests/editor-opens.e2e.ts tests/editor-files.e2e.ts tests/editor-select.e2e.ts tests/editor-bends.e2e.ts tests/editor-point-menu.e2e.ts tests/editor-move.e2e.ts tests/editor-pan-zoom.e2e.ts tests/editor-rail.e2e.ts tests/editor-page.e2e.ts tests/editor-style.e2e.ts tests/editor-status.e2e.ts tests/editor-interrupts.e2e.ts tests/editor-arrange.e2e.ts tests/editor-palette.e2e.ts tests/editor-clipboard.e2e.ts tests/editor-export.e2e.ts tests/drawing.e2e.ts tests/labels-edit.e2e.ts tests/labels-draw.e2e.ts tests/labels-caret.e2e.ts tests/labels-ime.e2e.ts tests/labels-view.e2e.ts tests/labels-select.e2e.ts tests/labels-drag.e2e.ts tests/snap.e2e.ts tests/serve.e2e.ts tests/embed.e2e.ts tests/cdp.e2e.ts tests/svg.e2e.ts --
scripts.e2e:agent: pnpm build && node scripts/queue.mjs e2e node scripts/fresh-tmp.mjs e2e run tests/visual.e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:shots: pnpm build && node scripts/queue.mjs e2e node scripts/fresh-tmp.mjs e2e run tests/screenshots.e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:linux: node scripts/queue.mjs e2e node scripts/fresh-tmp.mjs node scripts/e2e-linux.mjs
scripts.serve:editor: pnpm build && node dist/cli.js serve dist --port 4319
